headline: Tether Leads $15 Million Funding Round for AI Payments Startup Mural
summary: Stablecoin issuer Tether led a $15 million Series A funding round for New York-based AI-focused payment startup Mural, bringing its total funding to $28 million.
why: Tether is the issuer of USDT, the world's largest stablecoin, and frequently invests in blockchain and cross-border payment infrastructure startups.

impacts.name: Crypto & Payments
impacts.why: Venture funding rounds provide growth capital for early-stage fintech and digital asset infrastructure companies.
